Aisha: Pelago onboarding kickoff — quick sync. Goal: lock 30/60/90 owners, success criteria, and enablement schedule. Kickoff meeting Wed 9am PST. Can folks claim owners?
Miguel: I can own technical integration + infra playbook. Need Pelago infra lead contact (I think it's Priya).
Devon: I'll own enablement and feedback capture (weekly 30m enablement calls). I'll set up a shared doc. :memo:
Jordan: I'll handle commercial touchpoints and flag renewal timeline — contract anniversary in 10 months, low risk but we should confirm exec sponsor.
Aisha: Proposed success criteria: 1) Prod traffic to Redwood with p95 <200ms, 2) token cost within 20% of projection, 3) first 3 user flows validated end-to-end. Agree?
Miguel: Agree on perf target. Need model selection + quantization plan. @Aisha can we request a Dedicated trial window?
Aisha: I'll request Dedicated trial from sales ops and loop in @Jordan. Devon, can you add a model/quantization checklist to the doc?
Devon: Done — added checklist: ```- model selection
- batch settings
- KV cache config
- perf smoke tests
- cost estimates```
Aisha: Timeline draft: Week 0: kickoff & access; Week 1-2: integration + smoke tests; Week 3: enablement & runbooks; Week 4: go/no-go review. I'll post calendar invites.
Console Bot: Calendar event created: Pelago Onboarding Kickoff — Wed 2026-04-08 09:00 PST — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123
Jordan: Quick ask — who will capture customer feedback after each enablement session? We want artifacts for renewal playbook.
Devon: I'll run a short feedback survey (2 quick Qs + NPS) after each session and dump results into the onboarding doc.
Miguel: Tech question — intake mentioned PII. Does Pelago require Private deployment or VPC? That changes integration scope.
Aisha: They're targeting VPC for now. I'll confirm their security contact and note Private/on-prem as fallback if needed.
Devon: Risk log entry: renewal risk low but exec sponsor not yet confirmed. Added to doc under Risks > Exec alignment.
Aisha: Owners summary: Tech = Miguel, Enablement = Devon, Commercial = Jordan, CSM = Aisha. If no objections I will lock this plan by EOD and share the doc link.
Jordan: 👍
